Reusable approved upload procedure (no secret material):

Tool/surface: GitHub CLI v2.99.0 native `gh pr edit --attach`. Confirm availability with:
`gh pr edit --help | grep -- '--attach'`

Authentication prerequisite: an already-authenticated `gh` context with permission to edit the target repository/PR (credential store or platform-managed environment is fine), plus network access and readable local PNGs. Do not pass, print, or copy tokens/cookies. The supported endpoint abstraction is the CLI command; do not call an undocumented GitHub upload endpoint directly.

Template (preserves the existing PR body and appends uploaded images):
```
gh pr edit <PR_NUMBER> --repo <OWNER>/<REPO> \
  --attach '<PNG_PATH>#<ALT_TEXT>' \
  --attach '<PNG_PATH>#<ALT_TEXT>'
```
Exact shape that produced our three URLs:
```
gh pr edit 1 --repo yattdev/kandev-plugin-coordinator \
  --attach '.qa/screenshots/distinct-coordinator-reports-desktop.png#Desktop Reports view for Beta Workspace' \
  --attach '.qa/screenshots/distinct-coordinator-run-notice-desktop.png#Desktop Reports view after a manual cycle was queued' \
  --attach '.qa/screenshots/distinct-coordinator-chat-mobile.png#Mobile Chat view after switching to Alpha Workspace'
```
The CLI uploads each file and writes generated Markdown using stable URLs shaped `https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/<uuid>`.

If exact in-body placement is required, a complete body file may contain `![Alt](./image.png)` and be supplied together with `--body-file <FULL_BODY_FILE> --attach './image.png#Alt'`; GitHub CLI rewrites the relative reference. Warning: `--body-file` replaces the full PR body, so attachment-only is the safer first stage unless the owner has preserved and reviewed the complete body.

Readback:
```
gh pr view <PR_NUMBER> --repo <OWNER>/<REPO> \
  --json body,headRefOid,state,isDraft \
  --jq '{head:.headRefOid,state:.state,draft:.isDraft,urls:[.body|scan("https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/[0-9a-f-]+")]}'
```
Byte/content verification for every returned URL:
```
curl -L --fail --silent --show-error "$URL" -o /tmp/uploaded.png
sha256sum <LOCAL.png> /tmp/uploaded.png
cmp -s <LOCAL.png> /tmp/uploaded.png
file /tmp/uploaded.png
```
A zero `cmp` status proves the served attachment bytes match the staged PNG. This procedure requires no reusable secret and no access to the other task's files.
